title: 14 CFR § 107.47 Flight restrictions in the proximity of certain areas designated by notice to airmen. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 107.47 Flight restrictions in the proximity of certain areas designated by notice to airmen. (2025 edition)
sections.text: A person acting as a remote pilot in command must comply with the provisions of §§ 91.137 through 91.145 and 99.7 of this chapter.
